facts.note: The churchyard ground the chapel stands on is thirty-two blocks east to west.
Thirty-two blocks north to south: the nave and the loft at its south end, end to end, with ground round both.
Thirty-two blocks from under the ground to over the chapel's roof.
The nave is seven blocks across inside: an aisle and a short pew either side.
Thirteen blocks from the loft wall to the altar: room for the stair up the side and four rows of pews.
The loft floor stands five over the nave floor, so it is looked up at from the aisle and reached by a stair.
